18.Name: The Special One
18.Ability Description: Disable 3 dice from using any powerups. Triggers when your team rolls a sum less than 10 after adding in all powerups
18.Player Description: The Special One's known to turn every thing he touches to gold. But gold is extremely heavy.
18.In Game Description: Anchor 3 dice. Triggers when you roll less than 10 total.
18.Comments: 3 anchors on roll of less than 10

10.Name: Lionel Scrimmage
10.Ability Description: Change positive powers to negative, or vice versa for once dice. Triggers when the enemy rolls a sum higher than yours.
10.Player Description: How Lionel made it to the soccer pitch is anyone's guess. It's worrying that he appears to be refereeing the games with American football rules.
10.Unlock Criteria: Score an equalizer with less than 1:00 on the clock
10.In Game Description: Flip + and - for one dice. Triggers when enemy rolls higher than you.
10.Comments: Gives you an invert every time the enemy is higher than you

19.Name: Le Professeur
19.Ability Description: Add +2 to a dice when you roll a pair. Triggers only if your Bench is empty.
19.Player Description: He's miserly with his money but efficient with his expenditure. No excess required when you have a gifted young team. Or so he believes.
19.Unlock Criteria: Win 1 Match in Season 4 with an empty bench
19.In Game Description: Add +2 when you roll a pair. Triggers if Bench is empty.
19.Comments: 2+ on pair if bench is empty

11.Name: Sheikh Abdullah I
11.Player Description: Sheikh Abdullah's got a lot of money. It is said that he's secretly financing the entire Dice Soccer League! And all because his school going son invented the game!
11.Unlock Criteria: Score a tie breaker with less than 1:00 on the clock

12.Name: Ronin Chelskovic
12.Ability Description: A game that ends in a Draw awards you the same amount of money as a Win.
12.Player Description: He's drowning in cash but he'd much rather be drowning in an opponent's tears. He'll do anything for a win, even if it means buying a team and paying for it himself!
12.In Game Description: A Draw awards you the same as a Win.
12.Comments: Draw gets you same money as win

1.Name: Mary Hail
1.Ability Description: Add +5 to the dice of your choice, when your team rolls three identical numbers.
1.Player Description: Mary Hail hails from humble beginnings but is now living hale and hearty life as a Dice Soccer wife. She'll be there to cheer on her hubby come hail or snow, so keep your earplugs near!
1.In Game Description: Adds +5 when you roll a triple.

20.Name: Pierre Bear Stare
20.Ability Description: Give a yellow card to one dice. A second card on that dice will disqualify it from that turn. Triggers when an opponent dice rolls >7.
20.Player Description: Pierre's cold icy gaze will compel toward compliance the most petulant of players. There's no messing with this bloke, else the cards will come a-flying.
20.In Game Description: Give a yellow card if an enemy dice rolls >7.
20.Comments: If opponent rolls a dice with value 7 or higher, get one yellow card token

2.Name: Callie McLooney
2.Ability Description: Adds +1 to your total score whenever your team has possession of the ball.
2.Player Description: Callie's probably the most famous WAG of them all, given that she's been both wife AND girlfriend of the forward Vain Looney. She's extremely possessive, cheaters beware!
2.In Game Description: Adds +1 to your total when your team has possession.

13.Name: Sylvester Punter
13.Ability Description: Extra +15k if you win. -15k if you don't. Abandon at your own risk!
13.Player Description: This sly operator will take you up on any wager and though he doesn't look like much, he's got the thugs who'll come looking for you if you don't pay up!
13.In Game Description: Extra +15k if you win. -15k if you don't or abandon.
13.Comments: 15,000 win loss stakes. Cannot abandon match

3.Name: Miguel Panini
3.Ability Description: Re-roll any dice when your team rolls a sum less than 5, including all powerups.
3.Player Description: Miguel's a giant of the traditional game, and now spends his time promoting the Dice variant. He's extremely encouraging and loves to see teams reach their potential.
3.In Game Description: Re-roll a dice when your team rolls less than 5.
3.Comments: Makes sure don't roll too low

21.Name: Sir Al Flubberson
21.Ability Description: Quadruple the value of one dice. Triggers when your team rolls a pair.
21.Player Description: When it comes to tactics or tact, this attacking Knight goes straight for the jugular. You'll have to stick him down with chewing up to stop him!
21.In Game Description: Get a 4x token when your team rolls a pair.

14.Name: Hilly Will
14.Ability Description: Extra +50k if you win. -50k if you don't. Abandon at your own risk!
14.Player Description: Ol' Hilbert will make you an offer you can't refuse. But if you refuse to pay when you lose, you'll find yourself quickly amongst the next morning's refuse.
14.In Game Description: Extra +50k if you win. -50k if you don't or abandon
14.Comments: 50,000 win loss stakes. Cannot abandon match

4.Name: Maria Single
4.Ability Description: Add +1 to all your dice when your team rolls three identical numbers.
4.Player Description: She's on the prowl for promising talent, but rumor has it that this spinster's actually looking to be WAG some day. And the boys are just lining up in walls to impress!
4.Unlock Criteria: Score a goal with less than 1:00 on the clock
4.In Game Description: Add +1 to all your dice. Triggers on a triple.

5.Name: Remy Romantique
5.Ability Description: Add +2 to a dice when your roll a pair. Triggers only if there is at least one female on your team.
5.Player Description: He's a true lover of the game; the game of love that is. He'll have the girls swept off their feet faster than a sliding tackle, and they'll be glad to be sent off into his arms.
5.In Game Description: Add +2 on rolling a pair. Valid if there is a female on your team.

15.Name: Torna Hammstring
15.Ability Description: Permanent +1 Bonus to your team when you're one goal or more behind your opponent.
15.Player Description: Injury woes? Fatigue's gotten the better of you? Then nothing beats having the world's best physio on your side! Chase that win with vim and vigor!
15.In Game Description: Permanent +1 Bonus to your team when losing.
15.Comments: 1+ possession bonus to you and -1 possession bonus to enemy when you're not in the lead

6.Name: Milan Mariott
6.Ability Description: Add +1 to any dice when your team rolls a pair.
6.Player Description: She's not particularly a soccer fan, but she's heard the boys are cute so she'll offer some token support. It's coming out of her daddy's purse anyway!
6.Unlock Criteria: Be denied a goal with less than 1:00 on the clock
6.In Game Description: Add +1 to any dice. Triggers on a pair.

16.Name: Flashy Spice
16.Ability Description: Your team wins any turn that ends in a tie.
16.Player Description: She was born for attention and oh how she makes those heads and cameras turn! The perfect distraction for her hubby's team to capitalize on!
16.In Game Description: Your team wins any turn that ends in a tie.

7.Name: Dicey Dave
7.Ability Description: Doubles the value of one dice. Triggers when the enemy rolls a total higher than yours by 6 or more.
7.Player Description: He's no clown but he sure can turn a frown up side down. A morale boost always does the troops some good, especially when they're not on a roll.
7.Unlock Criteria: Save a goal with less than 1:00 on the clock
7.In Game Description: If the enemy beats you by more than five, double one dice.
7.Comments: If enemy has more than 5 points on you, get an extra 2x

8.Name: Shirley Tweety
8.Ability Description: Add or subtract 5 minutes from the clock. Triggers when 7 minutes remain.
8.Player Description: When Shirley makes an appearance, time stands still. Or maybe time just disappears as people stop and stare. Who can tell? She's so pretty!
8.Unlock Criteria: Win 1 Match with a WAG equipped
8.In Game Description: Add or subtract 5 minutes. Triggers at <7 minutes.
8.Comments: Add or minus 5 min from clock

17.Name: Parshall LeBlynde
17.Ability Description: Reduce a dice by half. Triggers when your team produces a 2x powerup.
17.Player Description: Parshall's never been the real athletic type. That's why he chose a life of refereeing instead. Too bad he's never been the observant type either.
17.Unlock Criteria: Win 1 Match in Season 4 with both Entourage slots empty
17.In Game Description: Reduce a dice by half if you produce a 2x.

9.Name: Jeff Blather
9.Ability Description: Swap powerups of 3 dice if your opponent rolls a sum more than 20, including all powerups.
9.Player Description: Jeff's a champion of the sport who has never come near being a champion at the sport. It's a strange controversy, or contradiction rather.
9.Unlock Criteria: Concede a goal with less than 1:00 on the clock
9.In Game Description: Swap powerups of 3 dice if your opponent rolls a sum more than 20.
9.Comments: If your enemy rolls more than 20, get 3 Feints
